title: Silver.Horizon.Repair.Split.2024.720p.WEB.x264-WEAVER
description: Six-volume PPMd .7z (8 MiB payload) with PAR2 parity, damaged in the second 64 KiB block of the fifth volume — beyond the chase's 128 KiB readahead from the first volume and beyond the end-header probe at the last. The first Damaged verdict gates the set, so the chase serves only vouched bytes and parks at the damage instead of racing it; repair then rewrites the volume and the chase resumes over it.
